chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said regarding those who abstained from fighting with him:
They abandoned the truth, but did not support the falsehood.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and ethical status of those who remain neutral in the face of truth and falsehood?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the phenomenon of passive neutrality, asserting that withholding support from the truth constitutes a betrayal of it, even if one does not actively aid falsehood. This insight is central to Shia political theology, particularly regarding the stance of the Sahaba during the early caliphates, where 'absence' was interpreted as a tacit endorsement of the prevailing power structure over divine right. It underscores that in matters of cosmic justice, silence is never neutral but rather a decisive act of abandonment.
